name: order_id
description: Commercial commitment order identifier (FIXED_TERM or AUTO_RENEW).

name: runtime_pool_id
description: Merged FCFS runtime bucket shared across commercial orders.

name: cloud_provider
description: Cloud or hosting platform (gcp, aws, azure, self_hosted).

name: scope_key
description: Platform scope key (GCP project/Shared-PT pool, Azure PTU deployment, or AWS PT ARN).

name: model
description: Canonical model identifier covered by this capacity order.

name: region
description: Serving region or multi-region of the capacity pool.

name: committed_units
description: Committed capacity units (GSUs, PTUs, or model units) in this order.

name: unit_rate
description: Hourly USD rate per committed capacity unit.

name: expiry_date
description: Commitment term expiration date (NULL for open-ended monthly auto-renew).

name: min_cache_tokens
description: Minimum prefix-cache token floor required by this model/pool.

name: supports_priority_paygo
description: TRUE when the endpoint supports Priority PayGo spillover.

name: emits_traffic_type
description: TRUE when the upstream model server attests TrafficType per response.

name: effective_from
description: SCD-2 inclusive UTC start timestamp for this order version.

name: effective_to
description: SCD-2 exclusive UTC end timestamp (NULL while active).
